messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex VII, 5

5. Evaluation report The notified body shall draw up an evaluation report that records the activities undertaken in accordance with point 4 and their outcomes. Without prejudice to its obligations vis-à-vis the notifying authorities, the notified body shall release the content of that report, in full or in part, only with the agreement of the manufacturer.

response.text:
The notified body | shall draw up | an evaluation report recording the activities under point 4 and their outcomes | | The notified body shall draw up an evaluation report that records the activities undertaken in accordance with point 4 and their outcomes.
The notified body | shall release | the content of the evaluation report, in full or in part | only with the agreement of the manufacturer; without prejudice to its obligations toward the notifying authorities | Without prejudice to its obligations vis-à-vis the notifying authorities, the notified body shall release the content of that report, in full or in part, only with the agreement of the manufacturer.
